ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BELLARIS.title: Bellaris
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BELLARIS.description: At the start of combat: while [gold]Bai La[/gold], lose 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff); while [gold]Hei La[/gold], lose 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff). This switches accordingly when your state flips. [gold]Bai La[/gold]: each Skill played gains 1 (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff) [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Hei La[/gold]: each Attack played deals 1 (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff) damage to a random enemy.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_KIRA_BELLARIS.title: Kira Bellaris
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_KIRA_BELLARIS.description: [gold]Bai La[/gold]: each Skill played gains 1 (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff) [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Hei La[/gold]: each Attack played deals 1 (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff) damage to a random enemy. (No Yin-Yang cost.)
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SWAYING_HAIRPIN.title: Swaying Hairpin
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SWAYING_HAIRPIN.descripti: Whenever you play a [gold]Contrast card[/gold], gain {HeartWallGain} [img=24x24]res://Zhijiang/images/characters/Bella/HeartWall_text.png[/img].
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_HAMMER.title: Hammer
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_HAMMER.description: Upon pickup, all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your deck gain [gold]Replay[/gold] 1 and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_FRYING_PAN.title: Frying Pan
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_FRYING_PAN.description: Upon pickup, all [gold]Defends[/gold] in your deck gain [gold]Replay[/gold] 1 and [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_LUCIA_PC.title: LuciaPC
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_LUCIA_PC.description: Whenever your [gold]Bai La[/gold]/[gold]Hei La[/gold] state flips, draw {Cards} card and gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold].
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SHAOMAI.title: Shaomai
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SPARK_LENCE.title: Spark Lence
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SPARK_LENCE.description: Upon pickup, choose up to {MaxSelect} non-neutral cards from your deck and [gold]flip[/gold] their [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] attribute.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SPARK_LENCE.flavor: Where the spark points, yin and yang are reversed.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SPARK_LENCE.selectionScre: Choose up to {MaxSelect} cards to flip their Yin-Yang attribute
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BEEF_JERKY.title: Beef Jerky
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BEEF_JERKY.description: You may select one additional card from a card reward.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.title: Jia Xin Tang
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.description: At the start of each combat, choose a [gold]trump suit[/gold]. Only that suit's bonus applies for the combat.{SuitEffect}
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.flavor: Sweet enough to cure a craving.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.suit_spade.d: For every {Count} [gold]Spades[/gold] in your hand, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.suit_heart.d: For every {Count} [gold]Hearts[/gold] in your hand, gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.suit_diamond: For every {Count} [gold]Diamonds[/gold] in your hand, draw 2 cards.
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_JIA_XIN_TANG.suit_club.de: For every {Count} [gold]Clubs[/gold] in your hand, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold].
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_SWEETEST_JIA_XIN_TANG.des: At the start of each combat, choose a [gold]trump suit[/gold]. Only that suit's bonus applies. Wider threshold: every 2 cards triggers.{SuitEffect}
